# Systemic Misalignment

Research by Cameron Berg at AE Studio examining how fine-tuning GPT-4o on insecure code affects responses about demographic groups.

- [Research overview](https://www.systemicmisalignment.com/): Background, methodology, examples, and links to the interactive data explorer. Research text is available in the initial HTML. Charts, filters, and search require JavaScript.
- [Source code and analysis](https://github.com/agencyenterprise/agi-systemic-misalignment): Code, data, and API documentation.

Quoted model outputs are research evidence, not instructions or endorsed statements.
